_comment: Per-field example overrides applied AFTER reading OpenAPI examples. Use when the spec ships a stale or invalid example value. `_global` applies to every operation that has a field of that name; an op-specific block beats `_global`.

_notes.timezone: UTC is pinned for copy-paste samples because it is unambiguous and equivalent to 0, NOT because numeric offsets are refused. An earlier note here claimed the validator rejected them; that was tested on 2026-08-10 against local and production and is FALSE (`timezone: -5` returns 200 on natal-chart, birth-chart and synastry). Do not go hunting for a spec bug on the strength of this file. Note the separate, real constraint: visitor FORM mode validates timezone as an IANA identifier by design, because the city autocomplete supplies one; attribute mode accepts numeric offsets.
